title: Run the Playwright browser tests (npm run test:e2e) in CI
detail: e2e/municipality.spec.ts is the only real-browser evidence that the invoice flow stays on the app's origin and that reset clears the municipality. CI currently runs only npm test. Adding a job changes .github/workflows and needs a CI supply-chain acknowledgement, so it was deferred from the municipality-data iterate. Fits naturally into the Bunny deploy iterate (step 3).

title: Step 2 (Bunny proxy): keep out-of-canton localities from silently becoming Zug invoices
detail: Bennau, Sattel, Rothenthurm and Mühlau share postcodes with a small Zug part and are accepted with only a hint. Today they are unreachable because suggestions are filtered to Zug postcodes; the new proxy must keep that filter (Post reports Bennau as SZ, so filter by Zug locality snapshot, not Post canton) or add a stronger confirmation when most of the locality lies outside Zug.
